v53:AddButton({
	Name = "Server Hop",
	Callback = function()
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    local PlaceId = game.PlaceId
    local JobId = game.JobId
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local v552 = string.format("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=Desc&limit=100", PlaceId)
        local v553 = game:HttpGet(v552)

        return (HttpService:JSONDecode(v553))
    end)
    local v389 = not ok
    if not v389 then
        v389 = not result or not result.data
    end
    if v389 then
        return
    end
    local t7 = {}
    for v393, v394 in ipairs(result.data) do

        if v394.playing < v394.maxPlayers and JobId ~= v394.id then
            table.insert(t7, v394.id)
        end
    end
    if #t7 == 0 then
        return
    end
    local v395 = math.random(1, #t7)
    local u396 = t7[v395]
    pcall(function()
        TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(PlaceId, u396, game.Players.LocalPlayer)
    end)
end
})
